problem_statement.task: Does the page load correctly and run without errors?
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Open the browser developer tools Console panel 2. Load the page and wait for complete rendering 3. Check if the Console has any red error messages (JavaScript errors) 4. Check if the Network panel has any failed resource requests (404/500)
problem_statement.expected_result: Page loads completely, Console has no red errors, Network panel has no failed requests (404/500), all static resources (CSS/JS/images/fonts) load successfully
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; JavaScript runtime errors deduct 5 points; Resource 404 errors deduct 3 points; White screen or crash results in 0 points; Warnings only do not deduct points

problem_statement.task: Verify Authentication layer functionality including toggle and validation
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Load the page and identify the Login form 2. Click the 'Sign Up' toggle and verify form switches to registration fields 3. Attempt to submit empty or invalid credentials 4. Verify visual error feedback (e.g., input shake animation or red error message)
problem_statement.expected_result: Login/Signup toggle switches forms correctly, invalid submission triggers clear visual error feedback (shake effect specified in requirements)
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 8 points; Toggle not working deduct 4 points; No error feedback/shake deduct 4 points; Missing Authentication layer entirely deduct 8 points

problem_statement.task: Test the 'Add New Feed' modal workflow and success feedback
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Click the 'Add New Feed' button in the sidebar 2. Verify modal appears with URL, Category, and Priority inputs 3. Fill in dummy data (e.g., Priority 'High') and click 'Save Feed' 4. Verify modal closes and a 'Feed Added' toast notification appears
problem_statement.expected_result: Modal opens with correct fields, submission closes modal, and a success toast notification is displayed
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 14 points; Modal does not open deduct 14 points; Missing inputs (Category/Priority) deduct 4 points; No success toast/feedback deduct 4 points; Modal fails to close deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Verify View Toggle functionality (Grid vs List) and layout rendering
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. In the Main Content area, click the 'Grid View' button 2. Take a screenshot to verify cards show large images with 'object-fit: cover' 3. Click the 'List View' button 4. Take a screenshot to verify layout changes to a compact text-heavy list
problem_statement.expected_result: Grid view displays cards with large, properly fitted images; List view displays compact text rows; toggling switches instantly between layouts
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; Toggles do not work deduct 6 points; Grid view images distorted (not cover) deduct 2 points; List view not compact deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Verify 'Priority Inbox' filtering logic and badge display
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Ensure at least one 'High Priority' source and one lower priority source exist 2. Click 'Priority Inbox' in the Sidebar 3. Verify only High Priority items are displayed in the feed 4. Check that displayed cards have a solid Medium Purple pill badge
problem_statement.expected_result: Priority Inbox filters out non-high priority items, High Priority items display the correct solid purple badge visual indicator
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 12 points; Filtering fails (shows low priority items) deduct 8 points; Missing priority badges deduct 4 points; Incorrect badge styling deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Test Read State management and opacity visualization
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Identify an unread feed item (full opacity) 2. Click the item to open content (or original link) 3. Return to the feed view 4. Verify the clicked item now appears with 50% opacity
problem_statement.expected_result: Clicking an item marks it as read, visually demonstrated by a reduction in opacity to approximately 50%
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; Item does not open deduct 4 points; Opacity does not change after reading deduct 6 points

problem_statement.task: Verify Search functionality within the Main Content area
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Note a specific keyword from a feed title 2. Type the keyword into the Header Search Bar 3. detailed check if the feed list filters to show only matching items 4. Clear the search and verify all items return
problem_statement.expected_result: Search input dynamically filters the feed list to match keywords in titles/descriptions, clearing restores full list
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 6 points; Search yields no results or incorrect results deduct 6 points; Filter doesn't clear properly deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Verify Sidebar Navigation structure and Smart Views
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. View the Sidebar (Left Panel) 2. Verify presence of User Profile section 3. Verify 'Smart Views' list contains: All Feeds, Priority Inbox, Unread Only, Saved/Starred 4. Check for Collapsible Categories list
problem_statement.expected_result: Sidebar contains User Profile, all specified Smart View options, and a Categories section
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 6 points; Missing User Profile deduct 1 point; Missing any Smart View option deduct 3 points; Missing Categories section deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Verify interactive Hover Effects on Buttons and Cards
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Hover over a primary Medium Purple button and check for color darkening (#7B68EE) 2. Hover over a Feed Card 3. Verify the card lifts (transform translateY) 4. Verify the shadow intensity increases
problem_statement.expected_result: Buttons darken on hover, Cards show a lift animation and increased shadow depth indicating interactivity
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 4 points; No button hover state deduct 2 points; No card lift/shadow effect deduct 2 points

problem_statement.task: Evaluate whether the interface visual design meets professional design standards
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. View the webpage screenshot to assess whether the overall color scheme is harmonious 2. Check if the layout spacing is reasonable (whether element spacing follows the 8px multiple principle) 3. Check if the typography system is professional (body font size ≥14px, line height exceeds 1.5x)
problem_statement.expected_result: The interface follows modern design principles: harmonious and unified color scheme, reasonable and standardized layout spacing, professional and clear typography system
problem_statement.criteria: Deduct 5 points for each instance of crowded visual elements, deduct 6 points for jarring color combinations, deduct 5 points for chaotic text and image layout

problem_statement.task: Verify Color Palette implementation and Soft UI styling
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Take a screenshot of the dashboard 2. Verify main background is Thistle (~#D8BFD8) and primary UI elements are Medium Purple (~#9370DB) 3. Check Feed Cards for white background, rounded corners (8-12px), and soft diffuse shadows 4. Verify Content Surface contrast against background
problem_statement.expected_result: Correct Thistle/Purple color theme applied, UI elements use specified rounded corners (8-12px) and soft shadows, creating a 'floating' card aesthetic
problem_statement.criteria: Full score 10 points; Incorrect background color deduct 4 points; Incorrect primary UI color deduct 3 points; Missing rounded corners or shadows deduct 3 points

instruction:
# Web page content
### 1. Page Structure & Layout
The application will be a Single Page Application (SPA) dashboard layout consisting of three main areas: a **Authentication Layer**, a **Navigation Sidebar**, and a **Main Content Feed Area**.

**A. Authentication Layer (Login/Signup)**
*   **Login Form:** Input fields for Email and Password. "Remember Me" checkbox. "Forgot Password" link.
*   **Sign Up Toggle:** Option to switch to a registration form requiring Email, Username, and Password.

**B. Navigation Sidebar (Left Panel)**
*   **User Profile:** Mini-profile section showing the username and a "Settings/Logout" dropdown.
*   **Global Actions:** A prominent "Add New Feed" button.
*   **Smart Views (Filters):**
    *   "All Feeds"
    *   "Priority Inbox" (Aggregates only High-Priority items)
    *   "Unread Only"
    *   "Saved/Starred"
*   **Categories List:** A collapsible list of user-defined categories (e.g., Tech, News, Photography) containing individual feed titles.
*   **Priority Toggles:** Quick filters for "High," "Medium," and "Low" priority feeds.

**C. Main Content Feed Area (Right/Center Panel)**
*   **Header Bar:**
    *   **Title:** Displays current view name (e.g., "All Feeds" or "Tech News").
    *   **Search Bar:** Allows searching for keywords within feed titles and descriptions.
    *   **View Toggle:** Buttons to switch between "List View" (Text-heavy, compact) and "Grid/Card View" (Image-heavy, for photos).
    *   **Sort Options:** Dropdown for "Newest First," "Oldest First," or "Priority High to Low."
*   **Feed Content Container:**
    *   **Feed Card (Component):**
        *   **Source Icon:** Favicon of the RSS source.
        *   **Feed Title:** The headline of the article.
        *   **Visual Media:** A thumbnail or full-width image (if available in the RSS item).
        *   **Snippet:** A 2-3 line preview of the text content.
        *   **Meta Data:** Publication date (relative time, e.g., "2 hours ago"), Category tag, and Priority Badge.
        *   **Action Buttons:** "Mark as Read," "Star/Save," and "Open Original."

**D. Modals & Overlays**
*   **Add Feed Modal:** Input for RSS URL. Options to assign a customized Name, select/create a Category, and set a Priority Level (High, Medium, Low).
*   **Feed Settings:** Interface to unsubscribe or change the priority/category of existing feeds.

---
# web page interaction
### 1. Interaction Logic
*   **Authentication:** Users must authenticate before accessing the dashboard. Invalid credentials trigger an error message shaking the input box.
*   **Fetching Strategy:** Upon login, the system attempts to fetch the latest data from all subscribed RSS URLs.
*   **Read State Management:**
    *   Clicking a feed item opens the full content (or original link) and automatically marks the item as "Read."
    *   "Read" items visual opacity is reduced by 50%.
*   **Prioritization Logic:**
    *   Users assign a priority level (High, Medium, Low) to a *Source* (not just an individual article).
    *   When "Priority Inbox" is selected, the system filters the main feed to show *only* items from High-Priority sources, sorted by date.

### 2. Interaction Action Sequence Example
**Scenario:** A user wants to add a photography blog, set it as "High Priority," and then view only high-priority image feeds.

**Step-by-Step Sequence:**
1.  **Initiate:** User clicks the "Add New Feed" button in the Sidebar.
2.  **System Response:** A modal overlay appears with an input field focused.
3.  **Input:** User pastes the URL `https://example-photo-blog.com/rss`.
4.  **Configuration:**
    *   User types "Photography" into the Category field (System auto-suggests existing categories or creates a new one).
    *   User selects "High" from the Priority dropdown menu.
5.  **Submission:** User clicks "Save Feed."
6.  **System Response:**
    *   Modal closes.
    *   A success toast notification appears: "Feed Added Successfully."
    *   The system fetches the latest items from the new URL.
7.  **Filter Interaction:** User clicks the "Priority Inbox" link in the Sidebar.
8.  **View Adjustment:** User clicks the "Grid View" icon in the Header Bar to emphasize images.
9.  **Result:** The Main Content Area refreshes to display a grid of large photo cards from the newly added photography blog (and other high-priority sources), excluding all medium/low priority text feeds.

---
# web page visual
### 1. Color Palette
*   **Primary Background:** **Thistle** (`#D8BFD8`). This will be applied to the main page body background to create a soft, welcoming atmosphere.
*   **Primary UI Color:** **Medium Purple** (`#9370DB`). This will be used for:
    *   Sidebar background (slightly darkened or fully saturated).
    *   Primary buttons (e.g., "Add Feed," "Login").
    *   Active navigation states (highlighting the selected category).
    *   Hyperlinks and icons.
*   **Content Surface:** **White** (`#FFFFFF`) or **Pale Lavender** (`#F3E5F5`). Feed cards and input fields will be white to ensure high contrast and readability against the Thistle background.
*   **Text Colors:**
    *   Headings: Dark Slate Blue or Deep Purple (for contrast).
    *   Body Text: Dark Grey (for readability).
    *   Meta Text (Dates): Medium Grey.

### 2. Aesthetics & Style
*   **Design Language:** Clean, Modern, Soft UI.
*   **Shapes:** Generous border radii (8px - 12px) on buttons, cards, and input fields to match the soft nature of the purple color scheme.
*   **Depth:** Soft, diffuse drop shadows on Feed Cards to make them "float" above the Thistle background.
*   **Typography:** A clean Sans-Serif font (e.g., Lato, Open Sans, or Roboto).
    *   Titles should be bold.
    *   Body text should have comfortable line height (1.5) for easy reading.

### 3. Visual States
*   **Hover Effects:**
    *   Buttons: When hovering over Medium Purple buttons, the color should darken slightly (`#7B68EE`) to indicate interactivity.
    *   Feed Cards: A slight lift (transform: translateY) and increased shadow when hovering over an article.
*   **Priority Indicators:** Visual badges on cards to indicate priority:
    *   *High Priority:* A solid Medium Purple pill badge.
    *   *Medium Priority:* An outlined Purple badge.
    *   *Low Priority:* A subtle grey badge or no badge.
*   **Images:** Images in the "Grid View" should be displayed with `object-fit: cover` to ensure uniform grid alignment without distortion.

---
